The error: bonds_formed expects format like "6-6" (atom types). We need to specify bond types using atomic numbers? For C-C bond, maybe "6-6". For C-O bond, "6-8". So bonds_formed should be ["6-6","6-8"]; bonds_broken also "6-8". Let's adjust.

Also functional groups names must match available list. We need to get list of functional groups. Use get_available_functional_groups.
